21.text: The Chukchee do not assimilate readily. Whenever they come in contact

22.text: with another tribe, they do not learn its language, but force the other to learn

23.text: theirs. The chief reason for this is that they are the greatest reindeer-breeders

24.text: in the country, and other tribes have to depend upon them for food and

25.text: sustenance. Thus it is that outsiders are forced to seek a means of easy

26.text: intercourse with them. The Maritime Chukchee in the immediate vicinity of

27.text: the Eskimo likewise learn very little of their language, while all the Eskimo

31.text: River, not far from the Russianized village of Markova, have not learned much
